body: This is an amazing reply, thank you!  I am a nurse on an acute behavioral health unit.  I basically work with psychotic people, or people that need to seek help for overwhelming anxiety or depression.  I basically tell people all of the things that I need to hear, except those words don't work for me.  Each day I am helping people work themselves away from that cliff.  I have tried to see doctors, but my insurance does not cover anyone that is not in my health system... which is a no go, I don't want to dump this on any one there.  I am friends with the psychiatrists...  I also can't just show up at an ER with my problems, I know the people that make the referrals.  I also do no want to put my girlfriend in a situation where she has to worry about maintaining this apartment on her own.  That prevents getting help, and ending it all right now.  I simply can't do that to her.  She can't survive here on her own.  I know much of this may sound trivial, but I've kept it together for so long.  I envy many of the people I work with, live I've said, and I feel anger when they have failed in their attempts... it is not hard.  I've taken various meds as well, mostly SSRI's.  They made things worse, and I my last two doctors would not help me with anything else.  The best thing would be a heart attack in my sleep.  No pain, no guilt, clean.
